items.heading: Draniki
details: Key ingredients: potatoes, onion, egg, flour, sour cream
Grate potatoes and onion finely, squeezing out excess liquid.
Mix with egg and a little flour to bind.
Fry spoonfuls of the batter in oil until crisp and golden on both sides.
Serve hot with a dollop of sour cream.

items.heading: Machanka
details: Key ingredients: pork, sausage, flour, sour cream, pancakes
Brown pork and sausage pieces in a pan.
Stir in flour and sour cream to build a creamy sauce.
Simmer until the sauce thickens and coats the meat.
Serve with thin pancakes for scooping up the sauce.
